scope: Six new profiles: IREDA, HCG, Fredun Pharmaceuticals, Milky Mist Dairy Food, HFCL and Genus Power Infrastructures. Business explanation, listing status and one dated context example each; not a financial audit.
method: TinyFish search and fetch for company, exchange and regulator pages; annual reports and offer documents downloaded and read locally. Each claim was compared with the source text before it was written.
financialPolicy: No financial amounts in the lessons. Verified full-year snapshots are not yet added, so the financial section for each profile shows the verification-pending state.

findings.evidence: FY 2025–26 annual report (lending model, sectors, funding, asset-quality table, Gensol account) and 19 October 2026 results release.
limits: Listing read from IREDA's own site links to NSE and BSE quote pages; exchange listing circular not opened.
The loan application, sanction and disbursement flow was taken from the annual report and general lending practice; the website's process-flow page loaded only as images.

findings.evidence: FY 2025–26 annual report (network, payer mix, risks, change of control, Milann held for sale) and 6 August 2026 results release (new north Bengaluru hospital, fertility business sold June 2026).
limits: How doctors are engaged and paid was not found in the report and is not described.
The term 'non-institutional revenue' used in the release was left out because it is not defined there.

findings.evidence: FY 2025–26 annual report (generics, exports, newer businesses, risk list) and 6 August 2026 results release (bonus issue, quarterly results).
limits: Fredun's own website does not load over https, so lesson sources use BSE filings; the company's http pages are linked only from the profile record.
Listed on BSE only according to the annual report; no NSE listing was verified.
Management's text is promotional; the lesson states this and describes health and wellness claims as the company's own.

findings.evidence: 29 October 2026 investor presentation, offer document of 6 August 2026 (milk procurement, use of proceeds, notices), NSE circular of 17 August 2026.
limits: Exact listing date not read from an exchange document; the label says 'listed August 2026'.
Market-share claims are the company's, citing one research report.

findings.status: added; acquisition and ammunition plant described as plans
findings.evidence: FY 2025–26 annual report and 22 July 2026 results release and presentation.
limits: The annual report refers to both 'definitive agreements' and a memorandum of understanding for the aerospace acquisition, so the lesson says only 'proposed'.
The very large supply agreement with an unnamed global hyperscaler is mentioned without amounts.

findings.status: added; buyback terms not verified from a filing
findings.evidence: FY 2025–26 annual report (smart-metering model, risks, key audit matter, borrowings) and exchange intimation of 19 October 2026 about considering a buyback.
limits: The 19 October notice could not be opened by the web reader; its content was read from the search excerpt.
The 26 October approval is shown on the company's investor page as a board resolution; the buyback's number of shares, price and dates come only from news reports, so the lesson does not state them.
Genus's website refuses automated downloads (HTTP 403), so annual-report and presentation copies are cited from NSE.
